nodes.label: Three-Layer CSS Token Cascade (Accent, Semantic, Component)
nodes.rationale: Separates OKLCH design tokens into Accent (--neon, --neon-glow, --neon-magenta, --neon-lime), Semantic (--primary, --background, --silver, etc.), and Component (--gradient-neon, --shadow-glow) layers so switching among 6 accent themes (.theme-*) or light/dark modes cascades automatically.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4 @theme inline Bridge
nodes.rationale: Uses @theme inline in src/styles/globals.css so Tailwind utility classes reference dynamic CSS variables at runtime rather than resolving static values at build time.

nodes.label: Glassmorphism (.glass-surface) & Motion Tokens
nodes.rationale: Defines standardized motion durations/easings with prefers-reduced-motion reset and a .glass-surface utility for chrome overlays while keeping message bubbles and cards solid for legibility and WCAG AA contrast.

hyperedges.label: SilverChat Tailwind v4 OKLCH Three-Layer Theme Cascade & Glass/Motion System
